title: Maximal Isotropic Delta Subspace
body_html:
Maximal Isotropic Delta Subspace

For each relevant positive-depth factor, the image \(D_i\) of \(\Delta^i\cap J_M^i\) in the finite symplectic quotient \[ W_M^i=J_M^i/J_{M,+}^i \] is a maximal totally isotropic subspace.
proof_html:
Extraction

Dimension equality follows from the graded isomorphism induced by \(d\alpha\). Isotropy follows by evaluating the symplectic form on pairs \((X,d\alpha(X))\), rewriting the target commutator by the transported good factor, and using trace invariance to cancel the source and target terms.
